data.name: Miriam
data.gender_notes: Miriam is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Miriam. Standard interpretations give 'beloved' or 'rebellious'; a popular alternative links it to mara, 'bitter'. Its root is Hebrew m-r-y-m. Miriam, sister of Moses and Aaron (Exodus 15:20). Miriam is a Hebrew name meaning “Beloved; (also) bitter; rebellious”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Miriam expresses “Beloved; (also) bitter; rebellious”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Miriam. Standard interpretations give 'beloved' or 'rebellious'; a popular alternative links it to mara, 'bitter'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Miriam total 36, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
